target.label: Flood within the next 3 days
target.definition: 1 if the reported flood period (in_flood_period) covers at least one of the next 3 calendar days, else 0; unknown (null) when any of those days is outside the data.

classes.label: Danger
classes.description: The model expects the event's flood on at least one of the next 3 days.

classes.label: No danger signal
classes.description: The model does not expect the flood in the next 3 days.

evaluation.description: Left out of the model on purpose; no forecast (see reason).
evaluation.reason: Not a rain flood: the Trishuli flood came from a glacier/rock collapse, so rainfall and soil moisture cannot forecast it. The notebook leaves it out of the forecasting data (cell 34), and so does this model.

provenance.scoring: Test events: the final model (trained on the training events). Training events: out-of-fold, the GroupKFold model that held that event out, so no event is scored by a model that saw it.
